steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Kanboard with username 'admin' and password 'admin'. After login, verify you are signed in (e.g. the dashboard or logout link is visible) and report what page you land on.

02-open: Navigate to the project named 'Bench Board' and open its board (the kanban view). Then report the names of the board's columns in their exact left-to-right order, exactly as displayed on the page. Do not modify or move any tasks. Report the column names as a list.

03-create: On the 'Bench Board' project board, create a new task with title exactly '{{runid}} Bench Task' and description containing the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench task created for run {{runid}}'). Create it in the '{{02-open.column_1_name}}' column (leave the column as {{02-open.column_1_name}} for now). Fill any required fields and submit. Then verify the task exists by opening its task page and report the task's numeric ID as displayed (Kanboard shows it like '#123'), the title, and confirm the description text contains '{{runid}}'. Do not modify any tasks whose title starts with 'Seed:'.

04-change: Move the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (task {{03-create.task_id_displayed}}) on the 'Bench Board' project so that it sits in the '{{02-open.column_3_name}}' column of the board. You can drag the card on the board or change its column from the task page — whichever works. Then verify by viewing the board that the card '{{runid}} Bench Task' is now in the '{{02-open.column_3_name}}' column, and report the column it is in. Do not move or modify any tasks whose title starts with 'Seed:'.

05-open: Open the task page for task {{03-create.task_id_displayed}} titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' on the 'Bench Board' project and add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment added for run {{runid}}'). Submit the comment form. Then verify the comment appears on the task page and report the exact comment text shown. Do not modify any tasks whose title starts with 'Seed:'.

06-set: On the task page for task {{03-create.task_id_displayed}} titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' on the 'Bench Board' project, set the task's due date to 2026-12-31 (December 31, 2026). Use the task's edit/details form (e.g. 'Edit this task' or the due date field) — the date format the app expects may be MM/DD/YYYY or similar; enter it so the app stores 2026-12-31. Save the change, then verify the task page shows the due date as 2026-12-31 (or 12/31/2026) and report exactly what the due date field displays. Do not modify any tasks whose title starts with 'Seed:'.

07-change: Final verification pass on the 'Bench Board' project (read-only, do not change anything): 1) Open the board and report the column names left-to-right exactly as shown. 2) Confirm the card for task '{{runid}} Bench Task' is in the '{{02-open.column_3_name}}' column and report its displayed numeric ID (like '{{03-create.task_id_displayed}}'). 3) Open that task's page and report: the task title, the task's numeric ID as displayed, the description text, the column it is in, the due date shown, and the text of any comments on the task. Report each of these values exactly as displayed on the page.
